issue: ALT 193.5 U/L (4.5x ULN) at Week 2 is flagged HIGH but no corresponding adverse event is recorded.
query_text: At the Week 2 visit (2013-08-14) ALT was 193.5 U/L (normal range 6–43 U/L, about 4.5x ULN), up from 16.0 U/L at Screening 1 (2013-07-24). AST (18.0 U/L) and bilirubin (13.68 umol/L) at that visit were within normal range. We could not find an adverse event on the AE form for this result. Please tell us whether the investigator considers the ALT value clinically significant. If yes, please add an AE entry with onset date, severity, relationship and outcome. If no, please confirm and give a short reason. Please also tell us whether any repeat liver tests were done after 2013-08-14 and, if they were, enter them.

issue: General anaesthesia and hydrocodone were started on 2013-08-27, which suggests a procedure, but no related AE, procedure or indication is recorded.
query_text: The Concomitant Medications form records GENERAL ANESTHESIA on 2013-08-27 and HYDROCODONE from 2013-08-27 to 2013-09-27, both with the indication "Prophylaxis or non-therapeutic use". This is after the last dose (2013-08-05) and within the follow-up period (AE Follow-up visit 2013-09-09). We could not find a matching adverse event or procedure on the record. Please describe the procedure or event that needed general anaesthesia on 2013-08-27 and its underlying reason. If that condition or event counts as an adverse event under the protocol, please add it to the AE form. Please also consider making the medication indications more specific.

issue: The disposition says treatment stopped because of AEs, but "action taken" is blank on all three AEs and all are still open as not recovered despite later follow-up visits.
query_text: The Disposition form records discontinuation on 2013-08-14 as "PMD DECISION DUE TO AE'S", and the last dose was 2013-08-05. The three application-site AEs (erythema and pruritus, both from 2013-08-02, and vesicles from 2013-08-05) have the "Action taken" field blank. Please tell us which AE(s) led to stopping study drug and complete "Action taken" for each AE (for example, drug withdrawn). Please also confirm the decision reason on the Disposition form: it is recorded as "Physician decision" although the stated reason is AEs. Finally, all three AEs are recorded as "Not recovered/not resolved" with no end date, despite the AE Follow-up visit (2013-09-09) and Retrieval visit (2014-02-11). Please update outcomes and end dates if they are known.
